headline_seed: Fast-moving wildfire in Reno, Nevada, forces tens of thousands to evacuate homes - The Guardian
draft_text:
#BreakingMews Hawk Fire near Reno forced 42,000 under mandatory evacuation Sunday. Six injured. Nevada Gov. Joe Lombardo declared a state of emergency and mobilized the National Guard. ABC News and CBS News confirm 0% containment.

And that's the mews.
